events.title: Reichstag Fire
events.description: The German parliament building (Reichstag) in Berlin was set on fire on the night of February 27. Dutch communist Marinus van der Lubbe was arrested at the scene, and the Nazi leadership blamed a communist conspiracy.
events.significance: The following day Hitler persuaded President Hindenburg to sign the Reichstag Fire Decree, suspending civil liberties and accelerating the Nazi consolidation of dictatorial power.

events.title: Dominican Republic Declares Independence
events.description: Led by Juan Pablo Duarte and the secret society La Trinitaria, Dominican patriots declared independence from Haitian rule, which had lasted since 1822.
events.significance: The date is celebrated as Dominican Independence Day and marks the founding of the modern Dominican Republic as a sovereign nation.

events.title: Discovery of the Neutron Announced
events.description: British physicist James Chadwick reported his discovery of the neutron, an uncharged particle in the atomic nucleus, in a paper submitted to the journal Nature in February 1932.
events.significance: The discovery transformed nuclear physics, enabled the understanding of nuclear fission, and earned Chadwick the 1935 Nobel Prize in Physics.

events.title: Gulf War Ends with Ceasefire Announcement
events.description: President George H. W. Bush declared that Kuwait was liberated and announced the suspension of offensive combat operations after a 100-hour ground campaign by the US-led coalition against Iraqi forces.
events.significance: The announcement effectively ended Operation Desert Storm, and a formal ceasefire followed, shaping Middle East geopolitics for decades.

events.title: Magnitude 8.8 Earthquake Strikes Chile
events.description: A massive earthquake struck off the coast of central Chile near Maule, triggering a tsunami that devastated coastal communities and killed more than 500 people.
events.significance: It was one of the strongest earthquakes ever recorded, prompting global tsunami warnings and a major re-evaluation of Chile's disaster preparedness and reconstruction efforts.
